biometric_attendance.title: Biometric Attendance & Salary System
biometric_attendance.pitch: End-to-end attendance and payroll system with biometric hardware sync, backend logic, frontend, and mobile app.
biometric_attendance.architecture: ZKTeco SDK sync, FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL, React frontend, Expo mobile app, automated payslip generation.
biometric_attendance.hardest_part: Aligning real-time attendance sync with salary engine logic and deployment across web and mobile.
biometric_attendance.impact: Reduced monthly payroll processing from over 2 hours to under 30 minutes.
likely_questions: How did you handle biometric hardware integration?
How did you design the salary engine?
How did you deal with leave, overtime, and deductions?
What would you improve next?

nsa_sports.title: NSA Sports Platform
nsa_sports.pitch: Role-based sports platform with registration, document review, approval workflows, automated emails, and CMS-driven content.
nsa_sports.architecture: Full-stack platform with role-based access, document workflow, configurable CMS, and automated rejection/reason emails.
nsa_sports.hardest_part: Designing approval/rejection workflows and CMS-driven content without requiring code changes.
nsa_sports.impact: Enabled player registration and club-based signups with admin-controlled review and automated communication.
likely_questions: How did you structure the role-based access model?
How did the CMS-driven content work?
How did you handle automated emails?
What would you improve next?

cas_parser.title: CAS Parser
cas_parser.pitch: Python desktop app extracting Demat holdings, mutual fund data, and transactions from unstructured CDSL PDF statements.
cas_parser.architecture: Tauri + PyInstaller desktop app, PyMuPDF, tabula-py, Pandas, ~98% extraction accuracy on 500+ statements/month.
cas_parser.hardest_part: Handling unstructured PDF format variations and maintaining accuracy across different statement layouts.
cas_parser.impact: Eliminated more than 10 hours/week of manual compliance data entry.
likely_questions: How did you handle PDF parsing challenges?
How did you measure accuracy?
What was the workflow from raw PDF to structured data?
What would you improve next?

fashiongallery.title: FashionGallery
fashiongallery.pitch: AI-powered fashion search and discovery with visual and text-based retrieval, clip-style embeddings, and RAG-style retrieval over fashion content.
fashiongallery.architecture: FastAPI backend, React/Next.js frontend, embedding-based similarity, RAG retrieval, Docker and deployment-ready structure.
fashiongallery.hardest_part: Making retrieval quality explainable and connecting embeddings, vector search, and retrieval into a usable demo.
fashiongallery.impact: Demonstrates practical AI application work beyond toy chatbots.
likely_questions: How does embedding-based search work?
How does RAG improve results here?
How would you evaluate retrieval quality?
What are the limitations of this approach?

infomatics_regtech.title: Infomatics RegTech / BFSI Work
infomatics_regtech.pitch: Enterprise RegTech and BFSI software involving SEBI compliance, trade surveillance, reconciliation, maker-checker workflows, and RBAC.
infomatics_regtech.architecture: Multi-tier approval workflows, automated reconciliation across multiple data sources, role-based access, automated reporting and email triggers.
infomatics_regtech.hardest_part: Handling complex compliance rules, restricted-trade detection, and workflow correctness across multiple user roles.
infomatics_regtech.impact: Automated 67+ SEBI report types, 500+ monthly CDSL statements with ~98% accuracy, and HR processing time reduced by ~60% via leave management.
